about: Review of a chess.com game still being played, behind a developer switch that ships off. Graded by gate 176 (TC-R247a..h) on a trial bundle at 375x761 with his insets and at 320x568, with every chess.com request answered by the gate's own route: with the switch off, and for a player with the switch's key set by hand, nothing shows and the in-progress list is never asked for; with it on the Daily games in progress are listed, a game one of his accounts plays in says its review opens when it ends and never reaches the engine, a game nobody of his plays opens as a review that grows with no tap when a move arrives, and the requests are spaced. NOT COVERED: a real chess.com response (the fixture is built from the API's documented shape; the network is closed in the container); the game-has-ended line and a game that ends while its review is open; a Chess960 Daily game; the Menu switch row's own tap; the growth on the move screen and the silence after closing are read at 375x761 only; his phone.

breaks.name: list-shows-with-the-switch-off
breaks.why: the feature no longer asks whether the switch is on: with the developer tools on and the switch never turned on, the games in progress are listed and chess.com's in-progress list is asked for

breaks.name: review-does-not-grow
breaks.why: the open review still asks chess.com about its game but never takes a new move in, so it stays at the moves it was opened with

breaks.name: own-game-reviewed-live
breaks.why: the own-game rule is off (LIVE_OWN_GAMES_WAIT false): a game in progress that one of his own accounts plays in opens and is analysed by the engine while it is being played
